Wähle den Ordner mit deinen Filmen. Zuer: Choose the folder with your films. First the files are only read and looked up on TMDB; nothing is saved until you click “Apply” below. If a Jellyfin or Kodi .nfo file sits next to a film, the match is certain. Otherwise names like “Title (Year)” help.
Wähle den Ordner mit deinen Serien, etwa: Choose the folder with your shows, e.g. on your NAS. Episodes are grouped by show and each show is looked up once on TMDB; nothing is saved until you click “Apply” below. Names like Show.S01E01, 1x01, E01 and season folders are recognised. A tvshow.nfo from Jellyfin or Kodi makes the match certain.
Choose the folder with your music (e.g. on the external drive). First it is only read and compared; nothing is saved until you click “Apply” below. There are no duplicates: if an album belongs to an existing CD, only “+ digital” with the file format is noted there.
